question: Does the sentence "Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers from the pepper patch" contain exactly 13 occurrences of the letter 'p' (ignoring case)?

claims.text: Picked, peck, pickled and patch each contain 1 'p'.
The words a, of, from, and the contain no 'p'.
Because the question says to ignore case, uppercase 'P' counts.
The only real risk is a miscount, and a second pass confirms 13.
